payload.description_html: Life restoration of Nothosaurus by Sebastian Brandt (Reco-Brandt), shown within a marine habitat. The model represents a predatory marine reptile from the Triassic, interacting with its underwater environment. The reconstruction illustrates morphology, locomotion and adaptation to aquatic life. The model is exhibited at the Natural History Museum Erfurt.
